name: forja
description: Five code-writing disciplines with an offline structural linter. Check function length, nesting, naming, duplication, and consistency with existing files before running the project's compiler and tests.

code.description: Write code with a chosen discipline, verified by a deterministic structural linter

interface.shortDescription: Code disciplines with practical structural checks.
interface.longDescription: Five code-writing disciplines: clean, defensive, functional, solid, and minimal-diff. Each output style includes rules and examples. The offline structural linter checks JS/TS and Python for function length, nesting, parameter counts, duplication, naming, debug leftovers, unused imports, and discipline-specific patterns. For existing files, minimal-diff compares indentation, quotes, naming, and semicolons with the original. Findings include concrete suggestions; passing requires at least 85/100 and no errors. Heuristics do not replace compilation, tests, or security review. Legacy installation and style identifiers remain compatible.
